title: Field Notes 03: myths vs facts about the four temperaments
caption:
The four temperaments are 2,400 years old, so a few myths have built up.

No, it isn't about your blood type. No, Fire people aren't always angry (they flare fast and cool fast). And no, you're not stuck with one element: most people are a blend.

Traditional wellness wisdom and self-reflection, not medical advice.

Which myth did you believe? Send this to the friend who still does.
